searchText: Do you have a link to these benchmarks? I don't propose changes, but because of the low price it may be tempting to remove not-strictly-needed checks. And this runs 20x slower than the EVM on average. <@122421399213047814> if you are asking me, I'll probably add the benchmark results later to the implementation PR. https://github.com/ethereum/evmone/pull/972 Was asking Kev, specifically bn254/bls benchmarks that show it is overpriced, but this is also helpful Ah right, the point eval precompile for example is doing a pairing, yet the whole precompile was cheaper than just doing a bn254 pairing — on mobile, so I can’t remember the difference, though I do remember it being significant You can also check the difference between eip2537 gas costs (though it’s not finalized) and the gas cost for the existing bn254 Just comparing field sizes, I would expect bn254 to cost something on the order of 30-40% less than bls12-381

excerpts.content:
Ah right, the point eval precompile for example is doing a pairing, yet the whole precompile was cheaper than just doing a bn254 pairing — on mobile, so I can’t remember the difference, though I do remember it being significant

You can also check the difference between eip2537 gas costs (though it’s not finalized) and the gas cost for the existing bn254
